assurance: Kernel-checked source statements; extraction and Go execution remain tested and trusted.

claims.name: UdpHeaderProofs.accepts_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (w : Wire), (∃ h, UdpHeader.parse w = ParseResult.ok h) ↔ 8 ≤ w.b4.toNat * 256 + w.b5.toNat

claims.name: UdpHeaderProofs.parse_lengthTooSmall_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (w : Wire), UdpHeader.parse w = ParseResult.lengthTooSmall ↔ ¬8 ≤ w.b4.toNat * 256 + w.b5.toNat

claims.name: UdpHeaderProofs.parse_ok_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (w : Wire) (h : Header),
  UdpHeader.parse w = ParseResult.ok h ↔
    8 ≤ w.b4.toNat * 256 + w.b5.toNat ∧
      h.srcPort.toNat = w.b0.toNat * 256 + w.b1.toNat ∧
        h.dstPort.toNat = w.b2.toNat * 256 + w.b3.toNat ∧
          h.length.toNat = w.b4.toNat * 256 + w.b5.toNat ∧ h.checksum.toNat = w.b6.toNat * 256 + w.b7.toNat

claims.name: UdpHeaderProofs.parse_serialize
claims.statement: ∀ (h : Header), 8 ≤ h.length.toNat → UdpHeader.parse (UdpHeader.serialize h) = ParseResult.ok h

claims.name: UdpHeaderProofs.parse_validate
claims.statement: ∀ (w : Wire) (h : Header), UdpHeader.parse w = ParseResult.ok h → UdpHeader.validate h = Validity.valid

claims.name: UdpHeaderProofs.payload_complete_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (h : Header) (available consumed : UInt32),
  UdpHeader.classify h available = Availability.complete consumed ↔
    h.length.toNat - 8 ≤ available.toNat ∧ consumed.toNat = h.length.toNat - 8

claims.name: UdpHeaderProofs.payload_need_more_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (h : Header) (available missing : UInt32),
  UdpHeader.classify h available = Availability.needMore missing ↔
    available.toNat < h.length.toNat - 8 ∧ missing.toNat = h.length.toNat - 8 - available.toNat

claims.name: UdpHeaderProofs.serialize_parse
claims.statement: ∀ (w : Wire) (h : Header), UdpHeader.parse w = ParseResult.ok h → UdpHeader.serialize h = w
